{{Quote|Boss, they just got Ketku!|Renegade Three, to [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]], during the [[Battle of Derra IV]]|<ref name="ESBr" />}}
A [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "'''Renegade Three'''" served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a member of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]]<ref name="RS/RF" /> [[Renegade Flight]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]], who the pilot called by the nickname "Boss", as did many other members of the [[Flight group/Legends|flight]].<ref name="ESBr" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], while escorting a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] carrying supplies from [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]] to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the Renegades were [[Battle of Derra IV|ambushed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. "Renegade Three" announced to [[Renegade Leader]] Narra the [[Death/Legends|death]] of fellow Renegade [[Ketku]], before being killed along with Narra and the rest of Renegade Flight, as the entire convoy was wiped out.<ref name="ESBr" />
